sections.extract: We applied the framework to guide the use of the RWT technique for evaluation of QI methods without gold standards. sections.title: Discussion and Conclusion
sections.extract: To answer the question of how accurately can QI methods be ranked without gold standards, we proposed a Cram´er–Rao bound-based framework. This framework quantifies the upper bound of correctly ranking the QI methods in the absence of gold standards.
